newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac says dollar gradually finding normal level.
newsitem.headline: Chirac says dollar gradually finding normal level.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac said on Wednesday the dollar was gradually adjusting to its normal level.

"We are beginning to reap the dividends of a policy of cleaning up (our finances) which has allowed an unprecedented reduction of interest rates," government spokesman Alain Lamassoure quoted Chirac as telling a cabinet meeting.
"We are also benefiting from the current rise in the dollar, which is gradaully finding its normal level," Chirac said, according to Lamassoure.
